C1364.title: Thetanuts Finance Legacy Vault Arithmetic-Flaw Exploit
C1364.summary: On June 15, 2026, a deprecated Thetanuts Finance vault that had been migrated years earlier was exploited for about $2.1 million. Security analysis attributed the issue to integer-division truncation in the legacy contract's mint function, which caused the deposit formula to evaluate to zero at low supply and allowed free token minting. Whitehat defenders recovered about $2 million in option tokens, while the attacker retained part of the assets.
